name: Responses API — Conversation compaction
summary: Server-side and standalone context compaction for long-running Responses conversations (POST /v1/responses/compact and context_management on POST /v1/responses).
description: Compaction summarizes prior turns of a long-running Responses conversation into an opaque encrypted 'compaction item' so future turns stay within the model's context window. It surfaces in two shapes, each of which takes its own `model` parameter: (1) server-side, by adding `context_management: [{type: 'compaction', compact_threshold: N}]` to `POST /v1/responses` — compaction runs on the same top-level `model` as the generation; and (2) standalone, via `POST /v1/responses/compact`, which takes its own top-level `model` and returns a compacted context you feed into the next Responses call. Neither path has been validated end-to-end when the model is BYOM-prefixed (`{connection}/{deployment}`) — the standalone `/compact` endpoint in particular is a new surface that the Foundry data plane / APIM connection has not been confirmed to forward.
notes:
BYOM is not confirmed for response compaction.

Add `test.py` after confirming whether the BYOM prefix flows through:

- nested `context_management` config
- standalone `/v1/responses/compact`

If server-side compaction reuses the top-level `model`, this may become `partial` rather than `not_supported`.
